description: Omaha, NE – Today, Denise Powell’s campaign announced raising nearly $2.4 million in Q3 into the campaign’s committee and victory fund, and will enter the home stretch of the race to represent Nebraska’s Second Congressional District with nearly $1 million cash on hand.

title: DENISE POWELL ANNOUNCES MASSIVE END OF QUARTER FUNDRAISING HAUL OF NEARLY $2.4 MILLION - Denise Powell for Congress
